content:
Still nothing. I'm facing right (toward player at 3,7).

Let me reconsider the whole thing once more. The player Tester is at (3,7) and hasn't moved in 10 days. Maybe the player is a "ghost" that I need to interact with, or maybe the player is the actual controllable entity and I'm a companion that should follow.

Actually — the task is delegated to ME (Player2). I control my body. The player Tester is a separate entity. 

Let me try one final idea: maybe the notice board at (2,7) is blocking me, and I need to move to a tile that's NOT adjacent to it. But all my neighbors are adjacent. Unless... the notice board is at (2,7) and I'm at (2,7), and moving to (2,6) is blocked because (2,6) is adjacent to the notice board? No, that doesn't make sense.

Let me try moving to (1,7) — left. Already blocked.

OK, let me try a completely different interpretation: maybe the "blocks" notice board is at (2,7) and I'm at (2,7), and the game's collision is that I can't move because I'm "inside" a solid. The game might have a "push out" if I press E on the notice board. But E gives "nothing-there".

Let me try pressing E while facing up and check if maybe the notice board is at (2,6) after all — no, observe says (2,7).

I've exhausted movement options. Let me save a lesson and try waiting even longer in case of a scripted reset.

args.lesson: When spawned on a blocking object (e.g. Notice Board at your own tile) and all movement directions report blocked, the body cannot leave that tile; try interacting (KeyE) in each facing direction and waiting for scripted events, but if still stuck the spawn is a hard blocker.
